profile.name: Zaber X-LCA4 LED控制器
profile.description: 这是一款多通道LED光源控制器，用于驱动和控制显微镜或光学实验中的LED照明通道。它可作为实验系统中的照明单元，为不同LED提供独立控制，适合荧光激发、透射/反射照明及多波段光学实验。
profile.description_en: This is a multi-channel LED light controller used to drive and control LED illumination channels in microscopy and optical experiments. It serves as an illumination control unit for independently managed LEDs, suitable for fluorescence excitation, transmitted/reflected illumination, and multi-wavelength optical setups.
